 1 | Prayer I | 1 target | 1 min/lvl | 100' | U

 3 | Resistance I | 1 target | 1 min/lvl | 100' | U

 5 | Cold Resistance | 1 target | 10 min/lvl | 100' | U
 8 | Temperature Sphere I | 10'R | 10 min/lvl | 10' | U

13 | Resistance III | 1-3 tgts | 1 min/lvl | 100' | U

17 | Protections Sphere III | 10'R | 1 min/lvl | 10' | U
18 | Prayer V | 1-5 tgts | 1 min/lvl | 100' | U
20 | Bless V | 1-5 tgts | 1 min/lvl | 100' | U
25 | Resistance V | 1-5 tgts | 1 min/lvl | 100' | U
30 | Protections Sphere V | 10'R | 1 min/lvl | 10' | U
50 | Protections True | 1 target | 1 min/lvl | 100' | U

# Descriptions
@@ 1
Target gets a special bonus of +5 to his resistance rolls and maneuver rolls.
If the target is more than 100' from the caster at any time, the spell is
cancelled.
@@ 2
As Prayer I, except target gets a special bonus of 5 to his defensive bonus
and maneuver rolls.
@@ 3
As Prayer I, except target gets a special bonus of 5 to his resistance rolls
and defensive bonus.
@@ 4
As Prayer I, except the duration is 10 minutes per level and the target is
protected from natural heat up to 170ºF (treat as if target were in 70ºF
temperature). For temperatures above 170ºF, subtract 100ºF to determine the
effective temperature for the target. Target also receives +20 to all RRs
versus heat spells and heat attacks (+20 DB versus elemental fire and heat
attacks).
@@ 5
As Prayer I, except the duration is 10 minutes per level and the target is
protected from natural cold down to 20ºF (treat as if target were in 70ºF
temperature). For temperatures below 20ºF, add 50ºF to determine the effective
temperature for the target. Target also receives +20 to all RRs versus cold
spells and cold attacks (+20 DB versus elemental cold and ice attacks).
@@ 8
All who are within the sphere are allowed benefits of either a Heat Resistance
or a Cold Resistance spell (must be the same for all targets). If the sphere
is more than 100' from the caster at any time, the spell is cancelled.
@@ 10
All within the radius are allowed the benefits of Prayer I or Bless I or
Resistance I spell (must be the same for all targets). If the sphere is more
than 100' from the caster at any time, the spell is cancelled.
@@ 11
As Prayer I, except total bonus is 15 and bonus may be spread over 1-3
targets. One target would get a special bonus of +15; three targets would get
+5 each; etc.
@@ 12
As Bless I, except total bonus is 15 and bonus may be spread over 1-3 targets.
One target would get a special bonus of +15; three targets would get +5 each;
etc.
@@ 13
As Resistance I, except total bonus is 15 and bonus may be spread over 1-3
targets. One target would get a special bonus of +15; three targets would get
+5 each; etc.
@@ 15
As Temperature Sphere I, except radius is 20'.
@@ 17
As Protections Sphere I, except all within the radius are allowed the benefits
of Prayer III or Bless III or Resistance III spell (must be the same for all
targets).
@@ 18
As Prayer I, except total bonus is 25 and bonus may be spread over 1-5
targets. One target would get a special bonus of +25; five targets would get
+5 each; etc.
@@ 20
As Bless I, except total bonus is 25 and bonus may be spread over 1-5 targets.
One target would get a special bonus of +25; five targets would get +5 each;
etc.
@@ 25
As Resistance I, except total bonus is 25 and bonus may be spread over 1-5
targets. One target would get a special bonus of +25; five targets would get
+5 each; etc.
@@ 30
As Protections Sphere I, except all within the radius are allowed the benefits
of Prayer V or Bless V or Resistance V spell (must be the same for all
targets).
@@ 50
Target gets a special bonus of +30 to his RRs, maneuver rolls, and DB and 30
is subtracted from all elemental attacks against him.
